errors.text_span: 具体来说是不同模型类型的表现
errors.evidence: The description infers that the chart shows the performance of "different model types". However, the legend indicates two different aggregation methods for the same 30 models: "Average of 30 model results" and "Voting result of 30 models".

errors.text_span: 垂直轴标注了“30个模型结果的均值”
errors.evidence: The vertical axis has no label. The text "30个模型结果的均值" (Average of 30 model results) is from the legend, describing the light gray bars, not the axis itself.
All light gray bars in the chart are visibly above the 70 line. The shortest bar has a value of approximately 70.5, not 68.

errors.text_span: 最长的深灰色柱高约为78
errors.evidence: All dark gray bars are clustered around the 75 line. None of the bars approach a value of 78. The longest bars are only slightly above 75.

errors.text_span: 对于每个编号，灰度柱和深灰色柱的高度差异不大，近似于相同的高度
errors.evidence: This statement is factually incorrect and misleading. In every group, the dark gray bar (value ≈75) is significantly and consistently taller than the light gray bar (value ≈70.5). Stating they are of "approximately the same height" misrepresents the primary visual information in the chart.
The description fails to mention the units for the y-axis, or that the units are not specified on the axis. The prompt requires a description of the units.
